verdict.rationale: Puzzle has an API and an MCP server, so scoped agent credentials is a fair question for this product. The evidence does not show that users can issue scoped or least-privilege credentials. API credentials (client id/secret, connection key) are provisioned manually by email with no documented scopes. The MCP 'write access turned on (Beta)' toggle is a related on/off access control, not the issuance of scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
